text: /* @component: .custom-swiper-indicator-ellipsis */ (function() { function initEllipsisSwiper() { const container = document.querySelector('.custom-swiper-indicator-ellipsis'); if (!container) return; function updatePagination(swiper) { const total = swiper.slides.length; const current = swiper.realIndex + 1; const paginationEl = container.querySelector('.swiper-indicator-ellipsis-pagination'); if (!paginationEl) return; let html = ''; function makeBullet(page, isActive) { return '' + page + ''; } function makeEllipsis() { return '...'; } if (total <= 7) { for (let i = 1; i <= total; i++) { html += makeBullet(i, i === current); } } else { html += makeBullet(1, current === 1); if (current > 3) html += makeEllipsis(); let start = Math.max(2, current - 1); let end = Math.min(total - 1, current + 1); if (current <= 3) end = 4; else if (current >= total - 2) start = total - 3; for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) { html += makeBullet(i, i === current); } if (current < total - 2) html += makeEllipsis(); html += makeBullet(total, current === total); } paginationEl.innerHTML = html; paginationEl.querySelectorAll('.custom-bullet').forEach(function(b) { b.onclick = function() { var idx = parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-index'), 10); swiper.slideTo(idx); }; }); } new Swiper('.custom-swiper-indicator-ellipsis', { slidesPerView: 1, spaceBetween: 20, loop: false, navigation: { nextEl: '.swiper-button-ellipsis-next', prevEl: '.swiper-button-ellipsis-prev' }, on: { init: function() { updatePagination(this); }, slideChange: function() { updatePagination(this); } } }); } if (!document.getElementById('swiper-css')) { const link = document.createElement('link'); link.id = 'swiper-css'; link.rel = 'stylesheet'; link.href = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.css'; document.head.appendChild(link); } if (typeof Swiper !== 'undefined') { initEllipsisSwiper(); } else { let script = document.getElementById('swiper-js'); if (!script) { script = document.createElement('script'); script.id = 'swiper-js'; script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js'; document.head.appendChild(script); } script.addEventListener('load', initEllipsisSwiper); } })();

display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 16px; .custom-bullet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-white); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--slate-500) 30%, transparent); transition: all 0.2s ease; &.is-active { color: #ffffff; background: var(--teal-500); font-weight: bold; } &:hover:not(.is-active) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--slate-500) 50%, transparent); } } .custom-ellipsis { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 18px; height: 28px; color: var(--slate-400); font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; pointer-events: none; }
